entries.title: Never ask for the visitor's location
entries.text: useSunTheme no longer calls the geolocation API: the timezone estimate (within about an hour of the real sunset) drives the theme and the weather tint. A theme is not worth a permission prompt.

entries.title: Voice: ConversationBar, LiveWaveform, MicSelector, useMicrophone; Sofia idles, listens and talks
entries.text: useMicrophone: device list, permission on start only, mute, live level and frequency bands (pull-based, per frame); simulatedVoice / simulatedBands for previews.

entries.title: The Vita mark: a frame of Sofia, generating
entries.text: A liquid spectrum ring with one drop at its heart and a glint on the lit rim; light and dark variants (softer glint, paler heart on dark). The favicon is the same drawing with the palette resolved to hex.

entries.title: Sofia on phones: the desktop liquid, on the GPU, at full resolution
entries.text: The CPU field drew a 128-cell grid and upscaled it, so phones saw a soft, low-detail orb. A WebGL2 shader now evaluates the desktop filter chain per pixel: each drop's blurred disk in closed form, summed (gooey bridges), thresholded where the chain does, rim-lit from the top left with an exact slope, and a pastel glow behind. Glints stay crisp on the 2D canvas above. The CPU field remains the fallback where WebGL2 isn't available.

entries.title: Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'
Homepage: hero and component canvas only
entries.text: The pillars and theme presets leave the homepage.

entries.title: Touch adapts by itself; the thinking orb draws without filters on phones; the icon catalog leaves the shared chunk (#1)
entries.text: Mobile was slow for three reasons, fixed here:

entries.title: Homepage: Sofia at the epicenter; 'See what you can make' gets its own page
entries.text: The hero centres on Sofia (Thinking generating, new 3xl 280px size for a landing page's epicenter); the component canvas stays right below.

entries.title: Rename the Loading component page to Thinking
entries.text: docs/components/loading.md → thinking.md; manifest, demos, sources and every 'related' list follow.

entries.title: Sofia flows: full frame rate, soft gaps, every figure moves, expressive modes
entries.text: Drawn every display frame (30/40fps caps made the liquid step).

entries.title: Sofia: outlined and segmented shapes, coloured glints, livelier motion
entries.text: Generating draws OUTLINES again (a filled body all looked alike), plus minimal segmented figures: dashed ring, three arcs, ( ), =, +, ×, ≡, wave, open C, three dots.

entries.title: Sofia: precise retrieving, many defined shapes for generating
entries.text: Retrieving uses a tighter melt: each recalled particle stays a distinct drop until it reaches the core.

entries.title: Sofia is super gooey: no sharp edges
entries.text: Wider goo blur with a gentler threshold: drops reach for each other through thick, rounded bridges instead of pinching.

entries.title: Button hover: the glare takes the squircle shape
entries.text: The tilt glare (::after) inherited the radius but not corner-shape, so on hover a plain rounded rectangle showed past the squircle , most visible on secondary buttons.

entries.title: Glass keeps its blur in production builds
entries.text: The minifier collapsed backdrop-filter + -webkit-backdrop-filter into the prefixed one only, which Chrome ignores. Declare the unprefixed property and let the build add the prefix.

entries.title: Ignore Vercel link and env files
Filtering: one row in the data table's toolbar
entries.text: Search, applied filter tags, Clear filters and the Filter trigger share the DataTable toolbar; the result count is the table description.

entries.title: Chat: earlier messages glide when the agent replies, never snap
entries.text: useFlip measures children relative to its container. Nested FLIP containers (chat thread inside its scroller) double-compensated the parent's move, so the column jumped down then slid back.

entries.title: Deploy-ready: showcase at the root, docs at /docs
entries.text: build:site renames the showcase to index.html and the docs to docs.html.

entries.title: Modal: every dismissal falls, only success flies up
entries.text: The exit stayed 'send' after one successful action, so later click-outside, Escape or × dismissals flew up. Each open and each dismissal now resets it to 'fall'.

entries.title: Dialog glass near-opaque (glass-4 fill 80%)
entries.text: Supersedes the 44% revision in the glass decision: dialogs must read as a solid sheet. Other tiers unchanged.

entries.title: Modal send exit stays solid until it leaves the viewport
entries.text: No fade: the sent modal travels the full viewport height at full opacity (240ms, accelerating), after the shorter 320ms success hold.

entries.title: Dialogs read first; successful modals leave faster
entries.text: glass-4 (dialogs, Spotlight) fill 12% → 44% so they no longer blend into the page; recorded as a revision of the glass decision.

entries.title: Spotlight previews one component; the docs home page is gone
entries.text: Component previews show ONE instance: the hero demo is trimmed down its layout wrappers to the first real component, centred, with room for full-width controls.

entries.title: Spotlight previews are never blank
entries.text: Content that sizes to its container (shells, full-width panels, chat panels, the Material demo) collapsed to zero width in the shrink-to-fit frame; it now lays out on a fixed 640px stage and is scaled down like a screenshot.

entries.title: Global search: Spotlight with live previews; header search button, dot separator, GitHub forks
entries.text: GlobalSearch (new component + pattern): a search button among the header's global actions (⌘K) summons a Spotlight-style glass panel near the top of the screen , no scrim, a large regular-weight field, results grouped by section with the top hit highlighted; arrows move, Enter opens, Esc clears then dismisses. A preview square shows the highlighted result made tangible: the page's live hero demo (shrunk to fit, inert), colour swatches for Color, a huge 'Aa' for Typography. Previews are lazy (functions), so only the shown one renders. Best-match ranking: labels starting with the query first.

entries.title: Header nav: lava-lamp highlight between links
entries.text: HeaderNav renders one highlight pill that slides (expressive spring) to the current link when the page changes, like the tabs pill; the active link keeps its weight and colour but no fill of its own. useIndicator now follows aria-current, and a resize right after a selection change (the new item turns medium weight) still slides instead of snapping , tabs and content switcher benefit too.

entries.title: One global nav everywhere
entries.text: src/playground/nav.ts holds the global nav (Start · Foundations · Components · Patterns · Decisions); the docs header and the showcase header both render it (the showcase links into the docs), so the top nav is the same on every page.

entries.title: Date picker morphs and returns to today; day states; header nav; highlighted option contrast
entries.text: Calendar: the frame eases between month heights (no snap), the month name morphs in with the default stagger, the year shows only when it isn't this year, and a Today button reveals beneath the grid once you leave the current month. Today's day has a small dot under the number.

entries.title: Focused fields stay white
entries.text: Text fields (and every field built on fieldClasses) and the composer keep the white field background while focused, even under the pointer; the grey hover fill now only applies at rest.

entries.title: Numbers are regular weight everywhere; mono demo shows a number
entries.text: Text renders numeric-only content ('12,840', '94%', '€1,240') in regular weight even inside a semibold role, unless a weight is passed explicitly (tabular-nums already enforced it for animated numbers, tables and KPIs). The Typography Mono demo uses 12,840 as its sample.

entries.title: Typography: mono weights demo; display and large title one step lighter
entries.text: Typography page: a Mono demo , every role in Google Sans Code at regular, medium and semibold, laid out like the Weights demo.

entries.title: Getting started section; Foundations trimmed; Changelog as a timeline; Timeline component
entries.text: New Getting started section (first): About Vita (the overview, formerly 'Overview'), Installation, CLI, Skills, Registry, then Mind, soul, body · Brand & voice · Design principles · Interaction moved from Foundations, and Changelog (formerly What's new).

entries.title: Accessibility: field labels, multiselect structure, listbox names; smaller KPI arrow
entries.text: Floating field labels use muted-foreground (≥ 4.5:1) instead of placeholder grey (3.6:1): a label is the field's name.

entries.title: KPI component; PageHeader with KPIs on the right
entries.text: Kpi: label → value (AnimatedNumber, regular weight, any Intl format) → trend (arrow + change + period, coloured by whether it's good for the metric via better=up|down, muted when flat) → helper; sizes sm/md/lg; loading skeleton. KpiGroup: related KPIs on one surface with dividers (bare inside headers).

entries.title: pnpm visual: real-browser layout, accessibility and screenshot checks; first a11y fixes
entries.text: scripts/visual.mjs: every docs page plus home and showcase in your installed Chrome (playwright-core, nothing downloaded), reduced motion. Fails on phantom scroll, elements gliding after load, and axe WCAG A/AA serious/critical issues; screenshots diffed against a local baseline (--update accepts, tests/visual/ is git-ignored). AGENTS.md step 8.

entries.title: Agent conversation: floating glass header and composer, time only, day separators, smooth arrivals; Sofia AI label
entries.text: MiniChat: the header floats like the global nav (8px inset, concentric radius) on glass-1 , the lower tier, since the panel is already glass , and the composer floats with no border or backing; the thread scrolls beneath both (padded by their measured heights).

entries.title: Nothing moves into place: no transitions before styles exist; layout glide is opt-in
entries.text: Root cause of elements flying in from the top left: the global 'everything transitions' rule applied while styles were being (re)applied , Vite injects CSS from JS and re-injects it on every hot update, so each element animated from its unstyled browser default (top-left, default sizes) to its styled place. Fixes:

entries.title: Changelog for v0.2.0
Release v0.2.0
Changelog, What's new and releases
entries.text: pnpm changelog: CHANGELOG.md (grouped by release tag, Unreleased since the last; breaking changes first, detected from 'Breaking' in the message) and docs/foundations/whats-new.md (the latest 30 changes as cards) from git history.

entries.title: Progress bar: soft liquid edges
entries.text: The liquid's coverage gets a small sideways blur (two box passes, ~0.35 tube height), so the tip's meniscus and drops fade softly instead of looking cut out. The solid body is composited on top, so it and the tube's top and bottom stay crisp; the bar still ends exactly on its value.

entries.title: Dropdown page merges Option and Multiselect; trailing meta/symbol; single choice has no tick
entries.text: One Dropdown page covers Dropdown, Combobox, Multiselect and the Option row (anatomy, states, rules, keyboard, every demo). The separate Option and Multiselect pages are gone.

entries.title: Nothing flies in from the top left; Multiselect page and chosen-first order; deprecation warnings
entries.text: useFlip (Stack/Inline) never records positions while its container is hidden (inactive tab, closed panel): children measured 0,0 there glided in from the top-left corner when it appeared.

entries.title: Tooltip: squircle corners, no arrow
entries.text: Breaking look: the pointer arrow is gone and the tooltip uses squircle corners (radius-md); proximity and the 6px offset tie it to its trigger.

entries.title: Decision records, exception review, AI card hugs content
entries.text: docs/decisions: a new Decisions section (playground nav, llms.txt, index.json). How Vita decides (records, supersede-don't-edit, three-team rule, exceptions, semver and deprecation) plus records for glass by elevation, status semantics, weather tint, buttons, motion, fields and options , each with the decision, why, rejected alternatives and when to revisit.

entries.title: IconPlaceholder: tint and solid surfaces; showcase conversations use ChatThread
entries.text: IconPlaceholder surface: 'tint' (default, a faint dark wash for white surfaces like notifications) or 'solid' (a white tile). ListItem , and so ContainedListItem , use solid inside grey list groups. New token icon-surface-solid (white; a faint lift in dark), mapped and documented.

entries.title: Vita mark adapts to dark mode
entries.text: In dark mode the mark's grey half uses deep greys (gray-700 → 500) instead of glaring light ones, and the navy points turn pale blue (blue-200) so they stay visible. The favicon follows the OS colour scheme the same way.

entries.title: Option component; whole-row selection with a left tick
entries.text: New Option (+ OptionList): the one list-item anatomy for every dropdown list , reserved left tick slot, optional icon, label and description; default/highlighted/selected/disabled states. Owns listClasses/itemClasses/tickClasses (dropdown re-exports them).

entries.title: Dropdown lists slide in from below; floating surfaces never grow from 0
entries.text: Dropdown/Select/Combobox lists enter with vita-list-rise (opacity + 8px rise, productive, no scale) and leave with vita-list-sink; reduced motion fades.

entries.title: Inputs: softer resting border
entries.text: border-field now matches border (light 0.827; dark 0.42) instead of the high-contrast 0.648. Hover still strengthens to border-strong and focus adds the ring; increased contrast keeps the ≥3:1 field border (0.45).

entries.title: Combobox: no blink on open
entries.text: Pressing the field no longer counts as an outside interaction (the field is the popover's anchor, not its trigger), which closed the list and instantly reopened it.

entries.title: Inline notifications on white; icon tiles are a faint dark wash
entries.text: Inline notifications and callouts sit on raised (white) instead of layer-1. icon-surface in light mode is 5% black (was solid white), so IconPlaceholder tiles read super-light grey on any surface, including the white notice.

entries.title: Shell layering: the page scrolls under the floating glass
entries.text: ShellMain fills the window and scrolls; Header, LeftPanel and RightPanel float above it (absolute, 8px inset) on their glass tiers, and ShellMain is padded to start below the header (64px) and beside the side nav on large screens (256px, or 64px for the rail , LeftPanel tells the shell which). Scrolled content now passes beneath the frosted header, so the material is actually visible. ShellMain publishes --vita-shell-top; the data table's sticky strip stops just below the header.

entries.title: Colour semantics, enforced
entries.text: registry/lib/status: one map from status meaning to colour, glyph, text and tint. StatusIndicator and notifications read from it; in-progress is info (never brand); warning glyphs use the base warning colour like every other status icon.

entries.title: Warning is orange
entries.text: -vita-hue-warning 62.6 → 50 and the palette's orange row moves with it (CSS + JSON), so warning reads orange rather than amber. warning-foreground keeps the same hue (darker) instead of drifting 27° toward red, which made warning text look like an error.

entries.title: Material foundation page
entries.text: New foundations/material: the glass tiers (layer, blur, fill, use), the rules (utility not recipe, tier by layer, see-through frost, elevated surface, lift, no filtered ancestors, reduced transparency) and the nevers; live demo of the five tiers over a busy backdrop. Color links to it instead of carrying the glass section.

entries.title: Notifications stack, newest on top; Header documents logo
entries.text: Banners stack: the newest in front on the highest layer, each older one a layer lower, peeking out 10px beneath and 5% smaller (three show). Pointing at or tabbing into the stack fans it out into a list (FLIP glides between the two). Header doc covers the logo prop.

entries.title: Glass: lower opacity, no bleaching
entries.text: Fills 24 · 20 · 16 · 12 · 8% (side nav → notifications) and the light-mode backdrop lift down from 1.12 to 1.03 , the strong lift was bleaching the near-white page behind the glass to flat white, so the frost and what's behind it were invisible.

entries.title: Vita brand mark and favicon; Header logo slot
entries.text: src/brand/vita-mark.tsx: the Vita mark , a thick ring, half a violet→blue arc (purple-400 → blue-500) and half soft grey, with three navy points (blue-900); turned 180°. Palette tokens only.
